Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG rear-aura sprite for an existing 2D RPG mercenary, ZERO. EFFECT ONLY. The character will be rendered separately by the game; do not draw any person, body, helmet, hands, feet, cape, scene, floor, text, or UI.

Create an imposing, elegant ASYMMETRIC SWORD-WING silhouette: FIVE long, detached blade-like spires of white radiant energy and finely beveled platinum metal, arranged behind an imagined warrior's upper body as an open angular fan. Three blades sweep upward and outward to the left at staggered angles and lengths; two sweep upward and outward to the right, with a narrower and steeper arrangement. The overall silhouette is tall and sharp with generous negative space, not stubby, not a solid shield. Each blade looks like an expertly painted futuristic ceremonial sword blade / wing spar, with a distinct pointed tip, broad polished white edge, translucent white energy spine, tiny restrained champagne-gold mechanical seams, and a very fine icy cyan inner glint. Keep most of the effect white and platinum, cyan only an accent. The central 25 percent of the composition remains largely transparent so an existing character's torso and head will stay readable when overlaid. Blade bases suggest a floating staggered array behind the shoulder blades, with no large central object. There is no circular halo or circular line anywhere.
Subtle white vapor filaments and a small number of sharp light fragments follow the outward direction of the blades. Strong crisp silhouette, rich painterly material shading, carefully controlled glow that does not hide the construction. Premium 2D anime science-fantasy illustration, original IP. This is a coherent rear ornament / sword-wing VFX asset, NOT ordinary angel feathers, NOT bat wings, NOT a round mechanical ring, NOT a logo.
Wide landscape canvas, roughly 3:2. Symmetric overall visual balance despite the 3-left / 2-right asymmetric shapes. Center the complete ornament. Every blade tip and all glow fit inside the canvas with at least 8 percent fully transparent margin. Use actual alpha transparency outside and between the blades. No black backdrop, no gray matte, no checkerboard painting. Do not include the character or any platform.
